summary: The pinned host passes its fail-closed ABI/renderer gates and focused ordering/action tests, but capability-rejected initial and swap renderer candidates are not unmounted. The previous browser traces are pre-UTF8 and do not establish current producer acceptance.

observations: initial rejected candidate was not unmounted; no Go Init or outer DOM writes occurred
swap rejected candidate was not unmounted; existing roots/state/callCounts remained; old callback still dispatched
parent event order/call counts were Update, Output, Input, parent View, child View; no Publication/Receive increment

finding.description: The assignment is not completed when requireRenderer throws on capability mismatch, so failure cleanup sees null and skips candidate unmount. Reproduced in initial mount and renderer swap.
finding.repair: Capture each factory return before capability validation; ensure rejected initial/swap candidates are unmounted once. Preserve the capability error if cleanup throws. Regression assertions must retain zero Go calls/outer DOM writes for initial mount and active old backend/callbacks after a failed swap.

limitations: No fresh browser run: E-HOST captures are from artifacts predating the UTF-8 producer repair, and strict literal acceptance was already red.
Shared module ABI validator is a pinned dependency; this scoped host review does not independently certify its implementation.
Test helper JavaScript reducers are host test doubles; they are not evidence of production JavaScript business transitions.
No claim of arbitrary module graphs, asynchronous effects, malicious-code isolation, or other browser/OS coverage.
